name: Coder
summary:
Coder provides secure cloud development environments for Kubernetes and modern platform engineering teams.

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate Coder environments across secure cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure platforms. From developer workspace deployment and platform integration through to operational enablement and governance, we help teams create consistent, scalable, and secure development environments.
overview:
Coder helps organisations standardise and secure developer environments by running cloud development workspaces on their own infrastructure. Together, we help teams provision scalable Kubernetes clusters and developer platforms that accelerate onboarding, improve developer productivity, and maintain enterprise-grade security and governance.

This partnership enables organisations to:

* Deliver browser-based and local IDE development environments
* Standardise development workflows across teams
* Reduce onboarding time for engineers
* Improve infrastructure efficiency with Kubernetes-native workspaces
* Maintain security and compliance through self-hosted infrastructure
* Scale platform engineering initiatives across hybrid and multi-cloud environments

Together with Coder, we provide a modern developer platform stack optimised for cloud-native engineering teams.
